title: bug: CQ-R10d4 exact Codex MCP table drops the shim's required MOE_ROLE
description: Pinned codex 0.166.0 (manifest member SHA b8a11fed…) starts a recorder MCP server with only HOME/PATH/LC_CTYPE, dropping parent MOE_ROLE=qa. guest-mcp-shim.py main() requires os.environ['MOE_ROLE']; R10d4's approved exact three-line config has no env_vars, so its Moe server cannot initialize. Repro/evidence: /tmp/r10d4-evidence/mcp-env-probe.py and mcp-env-*/env.json. Reconcile R10d4's approved contract (e.g. allow env_vars=["MOE_ROLE"] within the sole moe table) before completing that launch spec; do not weaken the shim's role validation.
definitionOfDone: Pinned Codex launches the real shim with the correct job role without copying credentials to configuration or argv.
R10d4 approved config contract and exact config tests agree with the role-forwarding behavior.
